bogie-frame-only:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: standalone transparent raster overlay component for an existing side-view steam train game; wheels will be separate animated assets.
Scene/backdrop: Genuinely transparent background with alpha channel, including all open voids. No checkerboard and no background color.
Subject: ONE isolated two-axle railroad bogie FRAME ONLY. Horizontal dark blackened-steel cast frame with frame arches, spring packs, and exactly two small axlebox/bearing caps, one at the left endpoint and one at the right endpoint. Axle cap centers must be on the same horizontal bearing line at roughly 20% and 80% of the image width. Cast frame arches and springs sit above that bearing line. Leave open voids around and below the two bearing caps for separately animated wheel faces.
Style/medium: Photorealistic detailed mechanical game component matching a blackened-steel steam locomotive. Medium charcoal cast steel, restrained worn silver edge highlights, crisp silhouette.
Composition/framing: Landscape canvas. Strict side-on orthographic horizontal elevation. No perspective or tilt. Entire isolated frame fully visible, centered, with generous fully transparent padding on every side.
Lighting: Neutral even material lighting, subtle surface highlights only; no cast shadow.
Critical constraints: FRAME ONLY. Absolutely no wheels anywhere, no tires, no circular rims, no spokes, no discs, no partial wheels, no rolling wheelset. Only the small axlebox/bearing caps may be rounded. No locomotive body, car body, vehicle, rails, track, ground, floor, text, lettering, labels, watermark, UI, or background. True transparent alpha everywhere outside the structural metal and inside all voids.
driving-wheel-neutral:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: standalone transparent raster component for an existing side-view steam train game.
Scene/backdrop: Genuinely transparent background with an alpha channel, including all open areas between the spokes. No checkerboard and no background color.
Subject: ONE neutral blackened-steel steam locomotive driving wheel. Exactly 12 evenly spaced radial spokes connected to a compact circular axle hub exactly at the geometric center. Perfectly circular continuous silver-steel outer tire. No offset crankpin, no coupling rod, no counterweight or protruding eccentric hardware.
Style/medium: Photorealistic detailed mechanical game component; medium charcoal blackened cast steel, subtly worn metal and a silver machined steel rim. Clear silhouette and readable contrast when displayed at 50–100 pixels.
Composition/framing: Square canvas. Strict orthographic face-on side elevation, camera directly on the wheel axle axis. Perfect circle, no tilt and no perspective, identical horizontal and vertical wheel diameter. Entire wheel centered and fully visible with generous fully transparent padding on all sides. Hub exactly at image center.
Lighting: Neutral even material lighting, subtle surface highlights only; no cast shadow.
Constraints: One wheel only; isolated component only. True transparent alpha outside the circle and between every spoke. No train, axle extending beyond face, rail, floor, object beside wheel, lettering, label, text, watermark, UI, or background.
